actor.description: Whom it invites, with their handle where it can be read: on listInvites.

joinPolicy.description: open admits anyone; approval queues a join request; invite requires an invitation. An invitation admits its recipient under any policy.

joinRequest.description: A request to join, waiting in the host.

actor.description: Who is asking, as a view names them.

groupView.description: A group as a list shows it. To a caller not signed in, only its did and handle.

address.description: The group's address here: one label under this host's handle domain, set when the group is made or arrives. Its handle, until the group takes one of its own.

siteDomain.description: The domain the group's website is served at rather than its address, when it is: its handle, a domain of its own (putSiteDomain).

url.description: The group's own site, if it keeps one.

joinPolicy.description: How new members get in, as the profile states it.

avatar.description: CID of the avatar blob; the host serves it at /img/{did}/{cid}, to whoever may see the profile.

deactivated.description: Set while a steward has the group switched off. Its spaces cannot be read until one of the stewards who could switch it off switches it back on.

banner.description: CID of the banner blob; the host serves it at /img/{did}/{cid}, to whoever may see the profile.

createdAt.description: When the group was started on this host.

groupViewDetailed.description: A group in full, as the viewer may see it. Profile fields and rules are present only when the viewer may read the meta space.

address.description: The group's address here: one label under this host's handle domain, set when the group is made or arrives. Its handle, until the group takes one of its own.

siteDomain.description: The domain the group's website is served at rather than its address, when it is: its handle, a domain of its own (putSiteDomain).

url.description: The group's own site, if it keeps one.

joinPolicy.description: How new members get in, as the profile states it.

avatar.description: CID of the avatar blob; the host serves it at /img/{did}/{cid}, to whoever may see the profile.

deactivated.description: Set while a steward has the group switched off. Its spaces cannot be read until one of the stewards who could switch it off switches it back on.

banner.description: CID of the banner blob; the host serves it at /img/{did}/{cid}, to whoever may see the profile.

rules.description: In the order they are presented. Absent when the meta space is closed to the viewer.

labels.description: The labels it defines, each with what it means and how apps should show it. Absent when the meta space is closed to the viewer.

memberCount.description: How many are in it. Present only when the viewer may read the members space, whose members listMembers gives a page at a time.

viewerState.description: The requesting account's standing in the group. Only present for authed requests. For a group switched off, nothing of their standing is read: member is false, roles and actions empty, and steward says whether they may switch it back on.

actions.description: The union of actions across the viewer's roles: what the host would let them do.

accepted.description: For a member: whether their own acceptance is in the members space.

request.description: The viewer's own pending request to join, when they are not a member and have one.

steward.description: For a group switched off, whose membership cannot be read: whether the viewer held group.configure when it was switched off, and so may switch it back on or delete it. Absent while the group is on.

labelSpaces.description: For a member: the group's spaces where their roles let them write labels as the group, by the scopes their roles hold across it or a space's policy grants them there.

grantable.description: For a member: of each action's scope and the group's authManageProfile and authModerate permission sets, those the viewer's roles hold enough of to add to a role. Adding any other is refused with ScopeNotHeld.

actorView.description: A person, as a view names them: their DID, and the handle their DID document names, when it can be read.

handle.description: The handle their DID document names; missing when it names none or cannot be read.

canCreateGroup.description: Only on the caller's own view, from getActor: whether this host lets them start a group (createGroup).

key.description: The role id: its record key.

bot.description: People with this role are bots.

default.description: Granted to members who join through requestJoin.

spaceView.description: One of the group's spaces: those in its index, and those left out of it (unlisted) to whoever may read them.

policy.description: Its policy, when the viewer may read the space.

address.description: The group's address here: one label under this host's handle domain, set when the group is made or arrives. Its handle, until the group takes one of its own.

url.description: The group's own site, if not at its address.

memberCount.description: How many people are in it. Only to its members.

sampleMembers.description: A few of its members, each as they are in the group, to show their faces. Only to its members.

action.description: What a holder of a role may do, as the host's methods ask: each is answered by the scope that grants it in the role's grant.

roleBinding.description: What one role may do, as the host reads its grant.

repoCollections.description: The public-repo collections holders may write as the group; `*` for any.

scopes.description: The role's scopes, as its role record has them.

roleRef.description: A role, by its id: the record key of a fyi.opensocial.role record.

scopeRef.description: An OAuth scope, as a permission or permission set is written.

actions.description: In a role's scopes: the actions the host reads this scope as granting.

collectionRef.description: A collection of records, by its NSID, or * for any.

modSubjectView.description: A subject in the moderation queue.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

actor.description: The account the subject is, or whose record it is, as a view names them.

modRecordView.description: A record subject as the host's index of its space holds it, shown to a moderator whom the space lets read it, even when the group has taken it down.

uri.description: The record's URI, in its space.

cid.description: The version the index holds, which may be newer than the one a report names.

createdAt.description: When the index read this version.

takenDown.description: Whether a !takedown label of the group's, in force, keeps this version from everyone reading the space. Its files are then served only through getModSubjectBlob.

moderationEvent.description: One event in the host's private moderation history.

createdBy.description: Hosts may withhold this to protect reporters and moderators.

creator.description: Who did it, as a view names them, when createdBy is given.

cid.description: The version of a record subject it is about, when it names one.

reportEvent.description: Someone reported the subject; with reasonType appeal, the subject appealed.

rule.description: A rule in the group's meta space.

statusEvent.description: A moderator set the subject's status, optionally with a note.

labelEvent.description: A label record (com.atproto.label.record) was written as the group, or deleted, which takes it back.

uri.description: The label record, as it was written.
